tools.name: validate_company_id
tools.description: Checks the format and check digit of a Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish or UK company number. Free.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Look up a company by registry number in Sweden (SE), Norway (NO), Finland (FI) or the UK (GB): official name, legal form, active/dissolved status, bankruptcy or liquidation, registration date, address and industry codes (+ employees, website, VAT where available). Official registry data. Costs $0.01
